output.reason: [ev-01e97dc9c4df] says 1.13 removed the wildcard view permission from the Kyverno controllers and added a binding to the default `view` role. The render diffs show `*/*` get/list/watch removed from the admission, background and reports controller ClusterRoles [ev-6af5be55b5f4][ev-0ae726bec846][ev-fbb2a078179b]. The bare name `*` is too broad: the validator refuted it because `kyverno.io/*` permissions still exist in 1.13 [ev-686e3f03e42c]. So the subject needs group `*`. replacedBy `*/view` is also wrong, because the replacement is a role binding to the `view` ClusterRole, not a permission with that name.

correction.statement: Kyverno 1.13 removes the wildcard view permission (all groups, all resources: get/list/watch) from its controller ClusterRoles. Instead, the controllers get a role binding to the default `view` role.
